question: Q-N-S1-D4
text: Which 10 dropoff zones received the most 2024 revenue from trips picked up at JFK Airport?
interpretation: The 10 dropoff zones with the most 2024 gross trip revenue from trips picked up at JFK Airport (ties: location id).
assemble: WITH ranked AS (SELECT q.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, do_location_id) AS rank_no FROM q WHERE trips > 0) SELECT rank_no, do_location_id, dropoff_borough, dropoff_zone, revenue FROM ranked WHERE rank_no <= 10 ORDER BY rank_no
